svg.title: Cornerstone Web Team design system portfolio concept
svg.desc: Fictional web design portfolio concept for Cornerstone Web Team, showing a design-system workspace with component and device previews. Purpose-built demonstration visual for LocalPro Directory; it does not depict a real business, credential, review or completed client project.
